messages:
jess: Hey all, first week here. Trying to run the repo's CI (we use both GitHub Actions and Buildkite). My PR shows GH Actions passing but Buildkite fails immediately with auth. Any quick checks?

rory: welcome! Do you have both the GitHub App and the Buildkite agent token configured? Which error are you seeing?

jess: Buildkite log: 
```
2026-03-21T09:03:12Z ERROR register: agent registration failed: 403 Forbidden
message: access denied for repository 'infra/first-week-templates'
```

rory: hmm that sounds like the Buildkite GitHub App doesn't have access to that repo. Onboarding sometimes walks folks through installing the GitHub App to their personal account by mistake.

tasha: Also note we use org-restricted repos. If the GH App was installed only to your user, Buildkite won't be able to create checks for the org repo. Go to Settings -> Installed GitHub Apps -> Redwood CI and ensure org 'redwood' is listed.

jess: I checked — app shows installed but repo list is empty (I must've clicked 'only select repos'). Can I change that or do I need someone from eng-infra to expand it?

rory: You can change it if you have org admin rights. If not, ping @tasha or @infra-bot and we'll request org-level access.

ci-bot: Note: GitHub App installation missing repo access for repo 'infra/first-week-templates'. Ticket auto-filed: https://tickets.redwood.com/issue/CI-2891

jess: I don't have org perms. Tasha, can you open the request?

tasha: On it. Requesting 'Selected repositories' -> add 'infra/first-week-templates' and enabling Deployments + Checks scopes. Will post when done.

infra-bot: Action required: @tasha requested to add repo access for 'Redwood CI' to 'infra/first-week-templates'. Approvers: @rory, @mel.

rory: Approved. Once added, you might still need to re-run the Buildkite webhook registration from the pipeline settings.

jess: Repo added by infra. I retriggered the Buildkite pipeline but now a different error: 
```
ERR: buildkite-agent: could not accept job: unknown pipeline: first-week-templates
status: 404
```

tasha: That usually means the pipeline slug doesn't match your Buildkite team visibility. Are you in the right Buildkite team and is the pipeline shared with your user?
jess: I'm in the default team. The pipeline slug looks correct in the repo settings.

rory: Check agent/token registration. If the agent isn't using a token with 'agent' scope for that team, Buildkite will reject jobs even if the webhook is fine. Run `buildkite-agent token list` on your host or check the token value in /etc/buildkite-agent/buildkite-agent.cfg.

jess: On the host the token is set to the value from the onboarding doc (from a DM I got a week ago). Could that be stale?

tasha: Yep, infra rotates the join tokens. Use the website: Buildkite -> Teams -> Agents -> New token (scopes: 'Agent') and copy it. Then on the VM `sudo sed -i 's/token=.*/token="<new-token>"/' /etc/buildkite-agent/buildkite-agent.cfg && sudo systemctl restart buildkite-agent`.

ci-bot: Reminder: Agent tokens older than 7 days are auto-revoked by infra policy.

jess: Regenerated token and restarted agent. Buildkite started picking up jobs. One flaky job is failing on a Docker pull: 
```
failed to pull image "gcr.io/redwood-ci/base:latest": received status code 403
```

rory: That 403 is from GCR permissions. For onboarding workers we use a service account mounted with a key on the VM. Did you provision the VM from the onboarding script or reuse an existing machine?

jess: Reused an existing dev VM. I didn't run the onboarding infra script.

tasha: OK you need the artifact-service account key in /etc/ci-creds/gcr-key.json and `gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file /etc/ci-creds/gcr-key.json` for the docker credential helper. I'll attach the key to your host via SSM now.

infra-bot: SSM session started for host 'jess-dev-1' by @tasha. Copying /etc/ci-creds/gcr-key.json.

jess: Got the key, ran auth, and docker pull works. Re-run of pipeline shows tests running now.

ci-bot: Buildkite build #201 started: https://buildkite.com/redwood/infra/201

jess: Tests passing now, thanks! Two quick asks: 1) can we add a small onboarding checklist for 'reuse VM' case? 2) who is the go-to for token rotations?

rory: Good idea — please open a tiny PR against docs/onboarding with steps for provisioning prebuilt VMs. Tag it 'quick-win'.

tasha: For token rotations ping #eng-infra and @infra-bot will auto-escalate if rotation affects pipelines. I'll also add you to the agent rotation doc.

jess: Will do. Appreciate the help — excited to be here. :wave:
